answer_1.quote: We propose a 7B-scale fine-tuned LLM, a.k.a. ChemActor, as a chemical executor to convert unstructured human-readable descriptions to structured machine-executable actions.
answer_1.outputs: structured machine-executable actions from unstructured chemical descriptions

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we assess performance using the Sequence Matching (SM) and ExactMatch (EM) metrics.

answer_3.quote: We design a multi-round LLMs circle review metric, using interactive debate prompting to prove ChemActor's advanced semantic understanding of chemical experimental knowledge.

answer_4.quote: We invite six Ph.D. and M.S. students from the department of chemistry to assess the prediction results on the CHEMTRANS test set.
answer_4.guideline: Each prediction is required to be scored on a scale from 0 to 10.
